correctness.rationale: Direct reconstruction covers all positive integers and all real X>=1: coprime product closure is proved; Dirichlet produces finitely many fixed-prime representatives per reduced class for each fixed Zumkeller modulus; 2023 Lemma 3.3 gives odd squarefree Zumkeller blocks for all sufficiently large indices; minimum-crossing algebra and the telescoping Euler product prove phi(z)/z>1/4 independently of index; CRT gives exact product of failure proportions; arbitrary finite r then forces upper natural density zero. No finite computation is substituted for the prime-block theorem or the infinite limit.

originality.rationale: The exact density-zero assertion is stated as the prime-summand half of Conjecture 4.21 in arXiv:2310.14149v2; inspected source proves infinitely many exceptions and a limited congruence-class positive result but not density one. Explicit equivalent-formulation, stronger-coverage, table, and claim-implication checks reveal no dominating prior result. The proof credits earlier block/closure lemmas and contributes the new Dirichlet+CRT density squeeze. Indexed-search incompleteness remains a risk.
residual_risks: Equivalent density-zero proof may exist in unindexed or unexamined literature, including later work.
Original 2013 coprime-multiplier article was not directly inspected; its needed lemma is fully reproved here.

value.rationale: Resolves the complete prime half of an explicit natural-density conjecture about representations by a divisor-partition class plus a prime; rules out positive-density exceptional sets even though infinitely many exceptions exist. The reusable structural method links infinite coprime Zumkeller prime blocks, reduced prime progressions and a uniform CRT sieve. Not merely a finite check or arbitrary restricted parameter case; the square-summand and pointwise assertions remain open here.
